// <auto-generated />
#nullable enable

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

namespace Atc.DependencyInjection;

/// <summary>
/// Extension methods for registering services decorated with [Registration] attribute.
/// </summary>
public static class ServiceCollectionExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Determines if a service type should be excluded from registration based on runtime filters.
    /// </summary>
    private static bool ShouldExcludeService(
        global::System.Type serviceType,
        global::System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<string>? excludedNamespaces,
        global::System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<string>? excludedPatterns,
        global::System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<global::System.Type>? excludedTypes)
    {
        // Check if explicitly excluded by type
        if (excludedTypes != null)
        {
            foreach (var excludedType in excludedTypes)
            {
                if (serviceType == excludedType || serviceType.IsAssignableFrom(excludedType))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        // Check namespace exclusion
        if (excludedNamespaces != null && serviceType.Namespace != null)
        {
            foreach (var excludedNs in excludedNamespaces)
            {
                // Exact match or sub-namespace match
                if (serviceType.Namespace.Equals(excludedNs, global::System.StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                    serviceType.Namespace.StartsWith($"{excludedNs}.", global::System.StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        // Check pattern exclusion (wildcard matching)
        if (excludedPatterns != null)
        {
            var typeName = serviceType.Name;
            var fullTypeName = serviceType.FullName ?? serviceType.Name;

            foreach (var pattern in excludedPatterns)
            {
                if (MatchesPattern(typeName, pattern) || MatchesPattern(fullTypeName, pattern))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Matches a string against a wildcard pattern.
    /// Supports * (any characters) and ? (single character).
    /// </summary>
    private static bool MatchesPattern(
        string value,
        string pattern)
    {
        // Convert wildcard pattern to regex
        var escapedPattern = global::System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Escape(pattern);
        var replacedStars = escapedPattern.Replace("\\*", ".*");
        var replacedQuestions = replacedStars.Replace("\\?", ".");
        var regexPattern = $"^{replacedQuestions}$";

        return global::System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(
            value,
            regexPattern,
            global::System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase,
            global::System.TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Decorates a registered service with a decorator implementation.
    /// </summary>
    private static IServiceCollection Decorate<TService>(
        this IServiceCollection services,
        global::System.Func<global::System.IServiceProvider, TService, TService> decorator)
        where TService : class
    {
        // Find existing service descriptor
        var descriptor = global::System.Linq.Enumerable.LastOrDefault(services, d => d.ServiceType == typeof(TService));
        if (descriptor == null)
        {
            throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException(
                $"No service of type {typeof(TService).Name} is registered. Decorators must be registered after the base service.");
        }

        // Remove existing descriptor
        services.Remove(descriptor);

        // Create new descriptor that wraps the original
        var lifetime = descriptor.Lifetime;
        services.Add(new ServiceDescriptor(
            typeof(TService),
            provider =>
            {
                // Resolve the inner service
                TService inner;
                if (descriptor.ImplementationInstance != null)
                {
                    inner = (TService)descriptor.ImplementationInstance;
                }
                else if (descriptor.ImplementationFactory != null)
                {
                    inner = (TService)descriptor.ImplementationFactory(provider);
                }
                else if (descriptor.ImplementationType != null)
                {
                    inner = (TService)ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance(provider, descriptor.ImplementationType);
                }
                else
                {
                    throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Invalid service descriptor");
                }

                // Apply decorator
                return decorator(provider, inner);
            },
            lifetime));

        return services;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Decorates a registered open generic service with a decorator implementation.
    /// </summary>
    private static IServiceCollection Decorate(
        this IServiceCollection services,
        global::System.Type serviceType,
        global::System.Func<global::System.IServiceProvider, object, object> decorator)
    {
        // Find existing service descriptor
        var descriptor = global::System.Linq.Enumerable.LastOrDefault(services, d => d.ServiceType == serviceType);
        if (descriptor == null)
        {
            throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException(
                $"No service of type {serviceType.Name} is registered. Decorators must be registered after the base service.");
        }

        // Remove existing descriptor
        services.Remove(descriptor);

        // Create new descriptor that wraps the original
        var lifetime = descriptor.Lifetime;
        services.Add(new ServiceDescriptor(
            serviceType,
            provider =>
            {
                // Resolve the inner service
                object inner;
                if (descriptor.ImplementationInstance != null)
                {
                    inner = descriptor.ImplementationInstance;
                }
                else if (descriptor.ImplementationFactory != null)
                {
                    inner = descriptor.ImplementationFactory(provider);
                }
                else if (descriptor.ImplementationType != null)
                {
                    inner = ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance(provider, descriptor.ImplementationType);
                }
                else
                {
                    throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Invalid service descriptor");
                }

                // Apply decorator
                return decorator(provider, inner);
            },
            lifetime));

        return services;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Registers all services from MyApp that are decorated with [Registration] attribute.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection.</param>
    /// <param name="configuration">The configuration used for conditional service registration.</param>
    /// <param name="excludedNamespaces">Optional. Namespaces to exclude from registration.</param>
    /// <param name="excludedPatterns">Optional. Wildcard patterns (* and ?) to exclude types by name.</param>
    /// <param name="excludedTypes">Optional. Specific types to exclude from registration.</param>
    /// <returns>The service collection for chaining.</returns>
    public static IServiceCollection AddDependencyRegistrationsFromMyApp(
        this IServiceCollection services,
        IConfiguration configuration,
        global::System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<string>? excludedNamespaces = null,
        global::System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<string>? excludedPatterns = null,
        global::System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<global::System.Type>? excludedTypes = null)
    {

        // Check runtime exclusions for UserService
        if (!ShouldExcludeService(typeof(MyApp.UserService), excludedNamespaces, excludedPatterns, excludedTypes))
        {
            services.AddScoped<MyApp.IUserService, MyApp.UserService>();
        }

        // Check runtime exclusions for Repository
        if (!ShouldExcludeService(typeof(MyApp.Repository<>), excludedNamespaces, excludedPatterns, excludedTypes))
        {
            services.AddScoped(typeof(MyApp.IRepository<>), typeof(MyApp.Repository<>));
        }

        // Check runtime exclusions for StripePaymentProcessor
        if (!ShouldExcludeService(typeof(MyApp.StripePaymentProcessor), excludedNamespaces, excludedPatterns, excludedTypes))
        {
            services.AddKeyedScoped<MyApp.IPaymentProcessor, MyApp.StripePaymentProcessor>("Stripe");
        }

        // Check runtime exclusions for EmailSender
        if (!ShouldExcludeService(typeof(MyApp.EmailSender), excludedNamespaces, excludedPatterns, excludedTypes))
        {
            services.AddTransient<MyApp.IEmailSender>(sp => MyApp.EmailSender.Create(sp));
        }

        // Check runtime exclusions for OrderService
        if (!ShouldExcludeService(typeof(MyApp.OrderService), excludedNamespaces, excludedPatterns, excludedTypes))
        {
            services.AddScoped<MyApp.IOrderService, MyApp.OrderService>();
        }

        // Check runtime exclusions for RedisCache
        if (!ShouldExcludeService(typeof(MyApp.RedisCache), excludedNamespaces, excludedPatterns, excludedTypes))
        {

            // Conditional registration for RedisCache
            if (configuration.GetValue<bool>("Features:UseRedis"))
            {
                services.AddSingleton<MyApp.ICache, MyApp.RedisCache>();
            }
        }

        // Check runtime exclusions for MemoryCache
        if (!ShouldExcludeService(typeof(MyApp.MemoryCache), excludedNamespaces, excludedPatterns, excludedTypes))
        {
            services.TryAddSingleton<MyApp.ICache, MyApp.MemoryCache>();
        }

        // Check runtime exclusions for MaintenanceService
        if (!ShouldExcludeService(typeof(MyApp.MaintenanceService), excludedNamespaces, excludedPatterns, excludedTypes))
        {
            services.AddHostedService<MyApp.MaintenanceService>();
        }

        // Check runtime exclusions for decorator LoggingOrderService
        if (!ShouldExcludeService(typeof(MyApp.LoggingOrderService), excludedNamespaces, excludedPatterns, excludedTypes))
        {

            // Decorator: LoggingOrderService
            services.Decorate<MyApp.IOrderService>((provider, inner) =>
            {
                return ActivatorUtilities.CreateInstance<MyApp.LoggingOrderService>(provider, inner);
            });
        }

        return services;
    }
